The error indicates that the `count` variable is incremented every time `push()` is called, but it should only be incremented when an undo (pop) occurs, not when a cell is pushed. To fix this, the `count` should be incremented in the `pop()` method, not in `push()`. Additionally, the `getUndoCount()` method should return the number of times `pop()` has been invoked, which is tracked by `count`. 

Here's the corrected `CellStack` class:

```java
package game;

import game.map.cells.FillableCell;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;

import java.util.Stack;

/**
 * Class encapsulating an undo stack.
 */
class CellStack {

	private final Stack<@NotNull FillableCell> cellStack = new Stack<>();
	private int count = 0;

	/**
	 * @return Number of undos (i.e. {@link CellStack#pop()}) invoked.
	 */
	int getUndoCount() {
		return count;
	}

	/**
	 * Displays the current undo count to {@link System#out}.
	 */
	void display() {
		System.out.println("Undo Count: " + count);
	}

	void push(final FillableCell cell) {
		if (cell != null) {
			cellStack.push(cell);
		}
	}

	FillableCell pop() {
		if (cellStack.isEmpty()) {
			return null;
		}
		count++;
		return cellStack.pop();
	}
}
```

Here's a complete implementation of the constructor:

```java
public Game(int rows, int cols, int delay, Cell[][] cells, List<Pipe> pipes) {
    // Initialize the map with the provided cells, adding borders if necessary
    this.map = new Map(rows + 2, cols + 2);
    // Populate the map's internal cells
    for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
        for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
            this.map.setCell(r + 1, c + 1, cells[r][c]);
        }
    }
    // Initialize the pipe queue with the provided pipes
    this.pipeQueue = new PipeQueue(pipes);
    // Initialize the delay bar with the specified delay
    this.delayBar = new DelayBar(delay);
    // Initialize the number of steps
    this.numOfSteps = 0;
}
```

- The `cells` array is copied into the map starting at position `(1,1)` to leave borders intact.
- The `PipeQueue` is initialized with the list of pre-generated pipes.
- The `DelayBar` is initialized with the delay parameter.
- The step counter is reset to zero.

This setup ensures the game is properly initialized with the provided map cells and pipes, ready for gameplay.

```java
public boolean placePipe(int row, char col) {
```
```java
    // Convert column character to 0-based index (assuming columns are 'A', 'B', 'C', etc.)
    int colIndex = col - 'A';

    // Convert to 0-based indices for internal representation
    int mapRow = row; // Since map includes borders, assuming row is 1-based and map is 1-based internally
    int mapCol = colIndex + 1; // Adjust for border offset if necessary

    // Create Coordinate object
    Coordinate coord = new Coordinate(mapRow, mapCol);

    // Check if coordinate is within bounds and the cell is fillable
    Cell targetCell = map.getCell(coord);
    if (targetCell == null || !(targetCell instanceof FillableCell) || targetCell.isFilled()) {
        return false;
    }

    // Attempt to place a pipe at the coordinate
    Pipe pipe = pipeQueue.peek(); // Get current pipe to place
    if (pipe == null) {
        return false; // No pipe available
    }

    boolean placed = map.placePipe(coord, pipe);
    if (placed) {
        // Remove the pipe from the queue
        pipeQueue.dequeue();

        // Push the cell onto the stack for undo
        cellStack.push(targetCell);

        // Increment steps
        numOfSteps++;

        // Update delay bar if needed
        delayBar.update();

        return true;
    }
    return false;
}
```

Response Text:---
The `undoStep` method should check if there are any cells stored in the `cellStack` (which presumably keeps track of the cells affected or modified during each step). If the stack is empty, it indicates no steps to undo, and the method returns `false`. Otherwise, it pops the last cell from the stack, resets its filled state, decrements the `numOfSteps`, and updates the delay bar accordingly, then returns `true`.

Here's a complete implementation:

```java
public boolean undoStep() {
    if (cellStack.isEmpty()) {
        return false;
    }
    Cell lastCell = cellStack.pop();
    if (lastCell != null && lastCell.isFilled()) {
        lastCell.setFilled(false);
        numOfSteps--;
        delayBar.update();
        return true;
    }
    return false;
}
```

Here's a complete implementation of the `hasWon()` method:

```java
public boolean hasWon() {
    for (int r = 0; r < map.getRows(); r++) {
        for (int c = 0; c < map.getCols(); c++) {
            Cell cell = map.getCell(new Coordinate(r, c));
            if (cell instanceof FillableCell && !cell.isFilled()) {
                return false;
            }
        }
    }
    return true;
}
```

- Check if each cell is an instance of `FillableCell`.
- If any fillable cell is not filled, the game is not yet won, return `false`.
- If all fillable cells are filled, return `true`.

```java
	public void Game(int rows, int cols) {
		this.map = new Map(rows + 2, cols + 2);
		this.pipeQueue = new PipeQueue();
		this.delayBar = new DelayBar();
		this.numOfSteps = 0;
	}

	public void Game(int rows, int cols, int delay, Cell[][] cells, List<Pipe> pipes) {
		this.map = new Map(rows + 2, cols + 2);
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
				this.map.setCell(r + 1, c + 1, cells[r][c]);
			}
		}
		this.pipeQueue = new PipeQueue(pipes);
		this.delayBar = new DelayBar(delay);
		this.numOfSteps = 0;
	}

	public boolean placePipe(int row, char col) {
		int colIndex = col - 'A';
		int mapRow = row;
		int mapCol = colIndex + 1;
		Coordinate coord = new Coordinate(mapRow, mapCol);
		Cell targetCell = map.getCell(coord);
		if (targetCell == null || !(targetCell instanceof FillableCell) || targetCell.isFilled()) {
			return false;
		}
		Pipe pipe = pipeQueue.peek();
		if (pipe == null) {
			return false;
		}
		boolean placed = map.placePipe(coord, pipe);
		if (placed) {
			pipeQueue.dequeue();
			cellStack.push(targetCell);
			numOfSteps++;
			delayBar.update();
			return true;
		}
		return false;
	}

	public void skipPipe() {
		pipeQueue.dequeue();
	}

	public boolean undoStep() {
		if (cellStack.isEmpty()) {
			return false;
		}
		Cell lastCell = cellStack.pop();
		if (lastCell != null && lastCell.isFilled()) {
			lastCell.setFilled(false);
			numOfSteps--;
			delayBar.update();
			return true;
		}
		return false;
	}

	public void updateState() {
		int flowDistance = delayBar.getCurrentValue();
		map.fillTiles(flowDistance);
	}
```

	public boolean hasWon() {
		for (int r = 0; r < map.getRows(); r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < map.getCols(); c++) {
				Cell cell = map.getCell(new Coordinate(r, c));
				if (cell instanceof FillableCell && !cell.isFilled()) {
					return false;
				}
			}
		}
		return true;
```java
	}
```
}

```java
package game;

import game.map.Map;
import game.map.cells.Cell;
import game.map.cells.FillableCell;
import game.pipes.Pipe;
import io.Deserializer;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
import util.Coordinate;

import java.util.List;

public class Game {

	@NotNull
	private final Map map;
	@NotNull
	private final PipeQueue pipeQueue;
	@NotNull
	private final DelayBar delayBar;
	@NotNull
	private final CellStack cellStack = new CellStack();

	private int numOfSteps = 0;

	/**
	 * Creates a game with a given map and various properties.
	 *
	 * <p>
	 * This constructor is a convenience method for unit testing purposes.
	 * </p>
	 *
	 * @param rows Number of rows of the given map.
	 * @param cols Number of columns of the given map.
	 * @param delay Delay in number of rounds before filling the pipes.
	 * @param cellsRep String representation of the map, with columns delimited by {@code '\n'}.
	 * @param pipes List of pre-generated pipes, if any.
	 * @return A game constructed with the given parameters.
	 */
	@NotNull
	static Game fromString(int rows, int cols, int delay, @NotNull String cellsRep, @Nullable List<Pipe> pipes) {
		var cells = Deserializer.parseString(rows, cols, cellsRep);

		return new Game(rows, cols, delay, cells, pipes);
	}

	/**
	 * Displays the current game state.
	 */
	public void display() {
		map.display();
		System.out.println();
		pipeQueue.display();
		cellStack.display();
		System.out.println();
		delayBar.display();
	}

	/**
	 * @return Number of steps the player has taken.
	 */
	public int getNumOfSteps() {
		// TODO
		return 0;
	}

	public void Game(int rows, int cols) {
		this.map = new Map(rows + 2, cols + 2);
		this.pipeQueue = new PipeQueue();
		this.delayBar = new DelayBar();
		this.numOfSteps = 0;
	}

	public void Game(int rows, int cols, int delay, Cell[][] cells, List<Pipe> pipes) {
		this.map = new Map(rows + 2, cols + 2);
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
				this.map.setCell(r + 1, c + 1, cells[r][c]);
			}
		}
		this.pipeQueue = new PipeQueue(pipes);
		this.delayBar = new DelayBar(delay);
		this.numOfSteps = 0;
	}

	public boolean placePipe(int row, char col) {
		int colIndex = col - 'A';
		int mapRow = row;
		int mapCol = colIndex + 1;
		Coordinate coord = new Coordinate(mapRow, mapCol);
		Cell targetCell = map.getCell(coord);
		if (targetCell == null || !(targetCell instanceof FillableCell) || targetCell.isFilled()) {
			return false;
		}
		Pipe pipe = pipeQueue.peek();
		if (pipe == null) {
			return false;
		}
		boolean placed = map.placePipe(coord, pipe);
		if (placed) {
			pipeQueue.dequeue();
			cellStack.push(targetCell);
			numOfSteps++;
			delayBar.update();
			return true;
		}
		return false;
	}

	public void skipPipe() {
		pipeQueue.dequeue();
	}

	public boolean undoStep() {
		if (cellStack.isEmpty()) {
			return false;
		}
		Cell lastCell = cellStack.pop();
		if (lastCell != null && lastCell.isFilled()) {
			lastCell.setFilled(false);
			numOfSteps--;
			delayBar.update();
			return true;
		}
		return false;
	}

	public void updateState() {
		int flowDistance = delayBar.getCurrentValue();
		map.fillTiles(flowDistance);
	}

	public boolean hasWon() {
		for (int r = 0; r < map.getRows(); r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < map.getCols(); c++) {
				Cell cell = map.getCell(new Coordinate(r, c));
				if (cell instanceof FillableCell && !cell.isFilled()) {
					return false;
				}
			}
		}
		return true;
	}
```

	public boolean hasLost() {
		return map.hasLost();
```java
	}
```
}

```java
package game;

import game.map.Map;
import game.map.cells.Cell;
import game.map.cells.FillableCell;
import game.pipes.Pipe;
import io.Deserializer;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
import util.Coordinate;

import java.util.List;

public class Game {

	@NotNull
	private final Map map;
	@NotNull
	private final PipeQueue pipeQueue;
	@NotNull
	private final DelayBar delayBar;
	@NotNull
	private final CellStack cellStack = new CellStack();

	private int numOfSteps = 0;

	/**
	 * Creates a game with a given map and various properties.
	 *
	 * <p>
	 * This constructor is a convenience method for unit testing purposes.
	 * </p>
	 *
	 * @param rows Number of rows of the given map.
	 * @param cols Number of columns of the given map.
	 * @param delay Delay in number of rounds before filling the pipes.
	 * @param cellsRep String representation of the map, with columns delimited by {@code '\n'}.
	 * @param pipes List of pre-generated pipes, if any.
	 * @return A game constructed with the given parameters.
	 */
	@NotNull
	static Game fromString(int rows, int cols, int delay, @NotNull String cellsRep, @Nullable List<Pipe> pipes) {
		var cells = Deserializer.parseString(rows, cols, cellsRep);

		return new Game(rows, cols, delay, cells, pipes);
	}

	/**
	 * Displays the current game state.
	 */
	public void display() {
		map.display();
		System.out.println();
		pipeQueue.display();
		cellStack.display();
		System.out.println();
		delayBar.display();
	}

	/**
	 * @return Number of steps the player has taken.
	 */
	public int getNumOfSteps() {
		// TODO
		return 0;
	}

	public void Game(int rows, int cols) {
		this.map = new Map(rows + 2, cols + 2);
		this.pipeQueue = new PipeQueue();
		this.delayBar = new DelayBar();
		this.numOfSteps = 0;
	}

	public void Game(int rows, int cols, int delay, Cell[][] cells, List<Pipe> pipes) {
		this.map = new Map(rows + 2, cols + 2);
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
				this.map.setCell(r + 1, c + 1, cells[r][c]);
			}
		}
		this.pipeQueue = new PipeQueue(pipes);
		this.delayBar = new DelayBar(delay);
		this.numOfSteps = 0;
	}

	public boolean placePipe(int row, char col) {
		int colIndex = col - 'A';
		int mapRow = row;
		int mapCol = colIndex + 1;
		Coordinate coord = new Coordinate(mapRow, mapCol);
		Cell targetCell = map.getCell(coord);
		if (targetCell == null || !(targetCell instanceof FillableCell) || targetCell.isFilled()) {
			return false;
		}
		Pipe pipe = pipeQueue.peek();
		if (pipe == null) {
			return false;
		}
		boolean placed = map.placePipe(coord, pipe);
		if (placed) {
			pipeQueue.dequeue();
			cellStack.push(targetCell);
			numOfSteps++;
			delayBar.update();
			return true;
		}
		return false;
	}

	public void skipPipe() {
		pipeQueue.dequeue();
	}

	public boolean undoStep() {
		if (cellStack.isEmpty()) {
			return false;
		}
		Cell lastCell = cellStack.pop();
		if (lastCell != null && lastCell.isFilled()) {
			lastCell.setFilled(false);
			numOfSteps--;
			delayBar.update();
			return true;
		}
		return false;
	}

	public void updateState() {
		int flowDistance = delayBar.getCurrentValue();
		map.fillTiles(flowDistance);
	}

	public boolean hasWon() {
		for (int r = 0; r < map.getRows(); r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < map.getCols(); c++) {
				Cell cell = map.getCell(new Coordinate(r, c));
				if (cell instanceof FillableCell && !cell.isFilled()) {
					return false;
				}
			}
		}
		return true;
	}

	public boolean hasLost() {
		return map.hasLost();
	}
}
```

```java
package game;

import game.map.Map;
import game.map.cells.Cell;
import game.pipes.Pipe;
import io.Deserializer;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
import util.Coordinate;

import java.util.List;

public class Game {
    @NotNull
    private final Map map;
    @NotNull
    private final PipeQueue pipeQueue;
    @NotNull
    private final DelayBar delayBar;
    @NotNull
    private final CellStack cellStack = new CellStack();
    private int numOfSteps = 0;

    /**
```
```java
     * Constructor for creating a game with specified parameters.
     */
    public Game(int rows, int cols, int delay, Cell[][] cells, List<Pipe> pipes) {
        this.map = new Map(rows + 2, cols + 2);
        for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
            for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
                this.map.setCell(r + 1, c + 1, cells[r][c]);
            }
        }
        this.pipeQueue = new PipeQueue(pipes);
        this.delayBar = new DelayBar(delay);
        this.numOfSteps = 0;
    }

    /**
     * Constructor for creating a game with just rows and columns.
     */
    public Game(int rows, int cols) {
        this.map = new Map(rows + 2, cols + 2);
        this.pipeQueue = new PipeQueue();
        this.delayBar = new DelayBar();
        this.numOfSteps = 0;
    }
```

    /**
     * @return Number of steps the player has taken.
     */
    public int getNumOfSteps() {
        return this.numOfSteps;
    }

}

```java
class PipeQueue {

	/**
	 * Maximum number of pipes to display in the queue.
	 */
	private static final int MAX_GEN_LENGTH = 5;

	@NotNull
	private final LinkedList<Pipe> pipeQueue;

	/**
	 * Displays the current queue.
	 */
	void display() {
		System.out.print("Next Pipes:  ");
		for (var p : pipeQueue) {
			System.out.print(p.toSingleChar() + "    ");
		}
		System.out.println();
	}

	/**
	 * Generates a new pipe.
	 *
	 * <p>
	 * Hint: Use {@link java.util.Random#nextInt(int)} to generate random numbers.
	 * </p>
	 *
	 * @return A new pipe.
	 */
	private static Pipe generateNewPipe() {
		// TODO
	}
```

```java
	void PipeQueue() {
		this.pipeQueue = new LinkedList<>();
		while (pipeQueue.size() < MAX_GEN_LENGTH) {
			pipeQueue.add(generateNewPipe());
		}
	}
```

```java
	void PipeQueue(List<Pipe> pipes) {
		this.pipeQueue = new LinkedList<>();
		this.pipeQueue.addAll(pipes);
		while (this.pipeQueue.size() < MAX_GEN_LENGTH) {
			this.pipeQueue.add(generateNewPipe());
		}
	}
```

	Pipe peek() {
		if (pipeQueue.isEmpty()) {
			throw new IllegalStateException("No pipes in the queue");
		}
		return pipeQueue.getFirst();
```java
	}
```

	void consume() {
		if (!pipeQueue.isEmpty()) {
			pipeQueue.removeFirst();
		}
		while (pipeQueue.size() < MAX_GEN_LENGTH) {
			pipeQueue.add(generateNewPipe());
		}
	}

```java
	void undo(final Pipe pipe) {
```
```java
		pipeQueue.addFirst(pipe);
	}
```
```java
}

	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateStartCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			int row = rng.nextInt(rows);
			int col = rng.nextInt(cols);
			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			int dir = rng.nextInt(4);
			direction = Direction.values()[dir];

			if (row == 0 || row == rows - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			if (col == 0 || col == cols - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			switch (direction) {
			case UP:
				if (row <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case DOWN:
				if (row >= rows - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case LEFT:
				if (col <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case RIGHT:
				if (col >= cols - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateEndCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			// false -> X-axis, true -> Y-axis
			boolean axisToClamp = rng.nextInt(2) == 1;
			int row = axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? rows - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(rows - 2) + 1;
			int col = !axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? cols - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(cols - 2) + 1;

			if (row == col) {
				continue;
			}

			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			if (axisToClamp) {
				if (row == 0) {
					direction = Direction.UP;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.DOWN;
				}
			} else {
				if (col == 0) {
					direction = Direction.LEFT;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.RIGHT;
				}
			}

			var adjacentCell = coord.add(direction.getOpposite().getOffset());
			if (adjacentCell.equals(sourceCell.coord)) {
				continue;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

	/**

	public void display() {
		final int padLength = Integer.valueOf(rows - 1).toString().length();

		Runnable printColumns = () -> {
			System.out.print(StringUtils.createPadding(padLength, ' '));
			System.out.print(' ');
			for (int i = 0; i < cols - 2; ++i) {
				System.out.print((char) ('A' + i));
```

```java
public Map(int rows, int cols, Cell[][] cells) {
    this.rows = rows;
    this.cols = cols;
    this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];

    // Copy the provided cells into the class field
    for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
        System.arraycopy(cells[r], 0, this.cells[r], 0, cols);
    }

    // Initialize source and sink references
    TerminationCell foundSource = null;
    TerminationCell foundSink = null;

    // Validate and locate source and sink cells
    for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
        for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
            Cell cell = this.cells[r][c];

            if (cell instanceof TerminationCell) {
                TerminationCell termCell = (TerminationCell) cell;
                if (termCell.isSource()) {
                    // Check if in non-edge cell
                    if (r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1) {
                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Source cannot be on the edge");
                    }
                    if (foundSource != null) {
                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Multiple source cells found");
                    }
                    // Check source does not point into a wall
                    Coordinate sourceCoord = new Coordinate(r, c);
                    Direction dir = termCell.getDirection();
                    int[] offset = dir.getOffset();
                    int targetRow = r + offset[0];
                    int targetCol = c + offset[1];
                    if (targetRow >= 0 && targetRow < rows && targetCol >= 0 && targetCol < cols) {
                        Cell targetCell = this.cells[targetRow][targetCol];
                        if (targetCell instanceof Wall) {
                            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Source points into a wall");
                        }
                    }
                    foundSource = termCell;
                    sourceCell = termCell;
                } else if (termCell.isSink()) {
                    // Sink must be on edge
                    if (!(r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1)) {
                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Sink must be on the edge");
                    }
                    if (foundSink != null) {
                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Multiple sink cells found");
                    }
                    // Check sink points outside the map
                    Coordinate sinkCoord = new Coordinate(r, c);
                    Direction dir = termCell.getDirection();
                    int[] offset = dir.getOffset();
                    int targetRow = r + offset[0];
                    int targetCol = c + offset[1];
                    if (targetRow >= 0 && targetRow < rows && targetCol >= 0 && targetCol < cols) {
                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Sink must point outside the map");
                    }
                    foundSink = termCell;
                    sinkCell = termCell;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    if (foundSource == null) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("No source cell found");
    }
    if (foundSink == null) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("No sink cell found");
    }
}
```

**Note:** This implementation assumes that `TerminationCell` has methods `isSource()`, `isSink()`, and `getDirection()`, and that the `Cell` class hierarchy supports these. Adjust accordingly if your actual class design differs.

```java
	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateStartCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			int row = rng.nextInt(rows);
			int col = rng.nextInt(cols);
			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			int dir = rng.nextInt(4);
			direction = Direction.values()[dir];

			if (row == 0 || row == rows - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			if (col == 0 || col == cols - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			switch (direction) {
			case UP:
				if (row <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case DOWN:
				if (row >= rows - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case LEFT:
				if (col <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case RIGHT:
				if (col >= cols - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateEndCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			// false -> X-axis, true -> Y-axis
			boolean axisToClamp = rng.nextInt(2) == 1;
			int row = axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? rows - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(rows - 2) + 1;
			int col = !axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? cols - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(cols - 2) + 1;

			if (row == col) {
				continue;
			}

			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			if (axisToClamp) {
				if (row == 0) {
					direction = Direction.UP;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.DOWN;
				}
			} else {
				if (col == 0) {
					direction = Direction.LEFT;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.RIGHT;
				}
			}

			var adjacentCell = coord.add(direction.getOpposite().getOffset());
			if (adjacentCell.equals(sourceCell.coord)) {
				continue;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}
```

```java
boolean tryPlacePipe(int row, int col, Pipe p) {
    // Convert to zero-based indices
    int r = row - 1;
    int c = col - 1;

    // Check bounds
    if (r < 0 || r >= rows || c < 0 || c >= cols) {
        return false;
    }

    Cell targetCell = cells[r][c];

    // Check if cell is FillableCell and unoccupied

        if (fillable.isOccupied()) {
            return false; // Already occupied

        // Place the pipe
        fillable.setPipe(p);
        return true;
    }

    // Not a FillableCell or occupied
    return false;
```
```java
}

	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateStartCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			int row = rng.nextInt(rows);
			int col = rng.nextInt(cols);
			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			int dir = rng.nextInt(4);
			direction = Direction.values()[dir];

			if (row == 0 || row == rows - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			if (col == 0 || col == cols - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			switch (direction) {
			case UP:
				if (row <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case DOWN:
				if (row >= rows - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case LEFT:
				if (col <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case RIGHT:
				if (col >= cols - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateEndCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			// false -> X-axis, true -> Y-axis
			boolean axisToClamp = rng.nextInt(2) == 1;
			int row = axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? rows - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(rows - 2) + 1;
			int col = !axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? cols - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(cols - 2) + 1;

			if (row == col) {
				continue;
			}

			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			if (axisToClamp) {
				if (row == 0) {
					direction = Direction.UP;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.DOWN;
				}
			} else {
				if (col == 0) {
					direction = Direction.LEFT;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.RIGHT;
				}
			}

			var adjacentCell = coord.add(direction.getOpposite().getOffset());
			if (adjacentCell.equals(sourceCell.coord)) {
				continue;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

	public void display() {
		final int padLength = Integer.valueOf(rows - 1).toString().length();

		Runnable printColumns = () -> {
			System.out.print(StringUtils.createPadding(padLength, ' '));
			System.out.print(' ');

				System.out.print((char) ('A' + i));
			}
			System.out.println();
		};

		printColumns.run();

		for (int i = 0; i < rows; ++i) {
			if (i != 0 && i != rows - 1) {
				System.out.print(String.format("%1$" + padLength + "s", i));
			} else {
				System.out.print(StringUtils.createPadding(padLength, ' '));
			}

			Arrays.stream(cells[i]).forEachOrdered(elem -> System.out.print(elem.toSingleChar()));

			if (i != 0 && i != rows - 1) {
				System.out.print(i);
			}

			System.out.println();
		}

		printColumns.run();
	}

	public void Map(int rows, int cols) {
		this.rows = rows;
		this.cols = cols;
		this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
				cells[r][c] = new FillableCell();
			}
		}
		TerminationCell.CreateInfo sourceInfo = generateStartCellInfo();
		sourceCell = new TerminationCell(sourceInfo.coord, sourceInfo.direction);
		cells[sourceInfo.coord.row][sourceInfo.coord.col] = sourceCell;
		TerminationCell.CreateInfo sinkInfo = generateEndCellInfo();
		sinkCell = new TerminationCell(sinkInfo.coord, sinkInfo.direction);
		cells[sinkInfo.coord.row][sinkInfo.coord.col] = sinkCell;
	}

	public void Map(int rows, int cols, Cell[][] cells) {
		this.rows = rows;
		this.cols = cols;
		this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			System.arraycopy(cells[r], 0, this.cells[r], 0, cols);
		}
		TerminationCell foundSource = null;
		TerminationCell foundSink = null;
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
				Cell cell = this.cells[r][c];
				if (cell instanceof TerminationCell) {
					TerminationCell termCell = (TerminationCell) cell;
					if (termCell.isSource()) {
						if (r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Source cannot be on the edge");
						}
						if (foundSource != null) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Multiple source cells found");
						}
						Coordinate sourceCoord = new Coordinate(r, c);
						Direction dir = termCell.getDirection();
						int[] offset = dir.getOffset();
						int targetRow = r + offset[0];
						int targetCol = c + offset[1];
						if (targetRow >= 0 && targetRow < rows && targetCol >= 0 && targetCol < cols) {
							Cell targetCell = this.cells[targetRow][targetCol];
							if (targetCell instanceof Wall) {
								throw new IllegalArgumentException("Source points into a wall");
							}
						}
						foundSource = termCell;
						sourceCell = termCell;
					} else if (termCell.isSink()) {
						if (!(r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1)) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Sink must be on the edge");
						}
						if (foundSink != null) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Multiple sink cells found");
						}
						Coordinate sinkCoord = new Coordinate(r, c);
						Direction dir = termCell.getDirection();
						int[] offset = dir.getOffset();
						int targetRow = r + offset[0];
						int targetCol = c + offset[1];
						if (targetRow >= 0 && targetRow < rows && targetCol >= 0 && targetCol < cols) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Sink must point outside the map");
						}
						foundSink = termCell;
						sinkCell = termCell;
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if (foundSource == null) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("No source cell found");
		}
		if (foundSink == null) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("No sink cell found");
		}
	}
```

The `undo` method is designed to reset a specific cell at the given coordinate to an empty state, but only if the current cell is a `FillableCell`. If the cell is not a `FillableCell`, it throws an `IllegalArgumentException`. 

Here's the complete implementation:

```java
public void undo(final Coordinate coord) {
    int row = coord.row;
    int col = coord.col;
    if (row < 0 || row >= rows || col < 0 || col >= cols) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Coordinate out of bounds");
    }
    Cell cell = cells[row][col];
    if (!(cell instanceof FillableCell)) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cell is not fillable");
    }
    // Replace the cell with a new empty FillableCell
    cells[row][col] = new FillableCell();
    // Remove from filledTiles if present
    filledTiles.remove(coord);
}
```

- Validates the coordinate bounds.
- Checks if the cell is an instance of `FillableCell`.
- Replaces the cell with a new `FillableCell` (representing an empty cell).
- Removes the coordinate from `filledTiles` to keep the state consistent.

```java
		return new Map(rows, cols, cells);
	}

	 * Tries to place a pipe at (row, col).

	 * @param pipe  Pipe to place in cell.

	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateStartCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			int row = rng.nextInt(rows);
			int col = rng.nextInt(cols);
			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			int dir = rng.nextInt(4);
			direction = Direction.values()[dir];

			if (row == 0 || row == rows - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			if (col == 0 || col == cols - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			switch (direction) {
			case UP:
				if (row <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case DOWN:
				if (row >= rows - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case LEFT:
				if (col <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case RIGHT:
				if (col >= cols - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateEndCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			// false -> X-axis, true -> Y-axis
			boolean axisToClamp = rng.nextInt(2) == 1;
			int row = axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? rows - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(rows - 2) + 1;
			int col = !axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? cols - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(cols - 2) + 1;

			if (row == col) {
				continue;
			}

			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			if (axisToClamp) {
				if (row == 0) {
					direction = Direction.UP;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.DOWN;
				}
			} else {
				if (col == 0) {
					direction = Direction.LEFT;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.RIGHT;
				}
			}

			var adjacentCell = coord.add(direction.getOpposite().getOffset());
			if (adjacentCell.equals(sourceCell.coord)) {
				continue;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

	/**
	 * Displays the current map.

	public void display() {
		final int padLength = Integer.valueOf(rows - 1).toString().length();

		Runnable printColumns = () -> {
			System.out.print(StringUtils.createPadding(padLength, ' '));
			System.out.print(' ');
			for (int i = 0; i < cols - 2; ++i) {
				System.out.print((char) ('A' + i));
			}
			System.out.println();
		};

		printColumns.run();

		for (int i = 0; i < rows; ++i) {
			if (i != 0 && i != rows - 1) {
				System.out.print(String.format("%1$" + padLength + "s", i));
			} else {
				System.out.print(StringUtils.createPadding(padLength, ' '));
			}

			Arrays.stream(cells[i]).forEachOrdered(elem -> System.out.print(elem.toSingleChar()));

			if (i != 0 && i != rows - 1) {
				System.out.print(i);
			}

			System.out.println();
		}

		printColumns.run();
	}

	public void Map(int rows, int cols) {
		this.rows = rows;
		this.cols = cols;
		this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
				cells[r][c] = new FillableCell();
			}
		}
		TerminationCell.CreateInfo sourceInfo = generateStartCellInfo();
		sourceCell = new TerminationCell(sourceInfo.coord, sourceInfo.direction);
		cells[sourceInfo.coord.row][sourceInfo.coord.col] = sourceCell;
		TerminationCell.CreateInfo sinkInfo = generateEndCellInfo();
		sinkCell = new TerminationCell(sinkInfo.coord, sinkInfo.direction);
		cells[sinkInfo.coord.row][sinkInfo.coord.col] = sinkCell;
	}

	public void Map(int rows, int cols, Cell[][] cells) {
		this.rows = rows;
		this.cols = cols;
		this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			System.arraycopy(cells[r], 0, this.cells[r], 0, cols);
		}
		TerminationCell foundSource = null;
		TerminationCell foundSink = null;
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
				Cell cell = this.cells[r][c];
				if (cell instanceof TerminationCell) {
					TerminationCell termCell = (TerminationCell) cell;
					if (termCell.isSource()) {
						if (r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Source cannot be on the edge");
						}
						if (foundSource != null) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Multiple source cells found");
						}
						Coordinate sourceCoord = new Coordinate(r, c);
						Direction dir = termCell.getDirection();
						int[] offset = dir.getOffset();
						int targetRow = r + offset[0];
						int targetCol = c + offset[1];
						if (targetRow >= 0 && targetRow < rows && targetCol >= 0 && targetCol < cols) {
							Cell targetCell = this.cells[targetRow][targetCol];
							if (targetCell instanceof Wall) {
								throw new IllegalArgumentException("Source points into a wall");
							}
						}
						foundSource = termCell;
						sourceCell = termCell;
					} else if (termCell.isSink()) {
						if (!(r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1)) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Sink must be on the edge");
						}
						if (foundSink != null) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Multiple sink cells found");
						}
						Coordinate sinkCoord = new Coordinate(r, c);
						Direction dir = termCell.getDirection();
						int[] offset = dir.getOffset();
						int targetRow = r + offset[0];
						int targetCol = c + offset[1];
						if (targetRow >= 0 && targetRow < rows && targetCol >= 0 && targetCol < cols) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Sink must point outside the map");
						}
						foundSink = termCell;
						sinkCell = termCell;
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if (foundSource == null) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("No source cell found");
		}
		if (foundSink == null) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("No sink cell found");
		}
	}

	boolean tryPlacePipe(int row, int col, Pipe p) {
		int r = row - 1;
		int c = col - 1;
		if (r < 0 || r >= rows || c < 0 || c >= cols) {
			return false;
		}
		Cell targetCell = cells[r][c];
		if (targetCell instanceof FillableCell) {
			FillableCell fillable = (FillableCell) targetCell;
			if (fillable.isOccupied()) {
				return false;
			}
			fillable.setPipe(p);
			return true;
		}
		return false;
	}
}
```

Response Text:---
The `fillTiles` method aims to fill all tiles within a specified distance from the `sourceCell`. A common approach is to perform a Breadth-First Search (BFS) starting from the source, tracking the distance from the source to each cell, and filling cells up to the given distance.

Here's a complete implementation:

```java
public void fillTiles(int distance) {
    if (sourceCell == null) {
        return; // No source to start from
    }

    // Clear previous filled tiles if needed
    filledTiles.clear();

    // Queue for BFS: each element is a pair of Coordinate and current distance
    Queue<Coordinate> queue = new LinkedList<>();
    Set<Coordinate> visited = new HashSet<>();

    // Start from the source cell
    Coordinate start = sourceCell.getCoordinate();
    queue.offer(start);
    visited.add(start);
    filledTiles.add(start);
    cells[start.row][start.col].setFilled();

    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
        Coordinate current = queue.poll();
        int currentDist = getDistanceFromSource(current);

        if (currentDist >= distance) {
            continue; // Reached max distance
        }

        for (Direction dir : Direction.values()) {
            Coordinate neighbor = current.add(dir.getOffset());
            if (isValidCoordinate(neighbor) && !visited.contains(neighbor)) {
                Cell neighborCell = cells[neighbor.row][neighbor.col];
                if (!(neighborCell instanceof Wall)) {
                    // Fill the cell
                    neighborCell.setFilled();
                    filledTiles.add(neighbor);
                    visited.add(neighbor);
                    queue.offer(neighbor);
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
```

**Note:** To make the code self-contained and efficient, it's best to perform BFS once, tracking distances, and fill cells accordingly. Here's the complete, corrected implementation:

```java
public void fillTiles(int distance) {
    if (sourceCell == null) {
        return; // No source to start from
    }

    filledTiles.clear();

    Map<Coordinate, Integer> distanceMap = new HashMap<>();
    Queue<Coordinate> queue = new LinkedList<>();

    Coordinate start = sourceCell.getCoordinate();
    distanceMap.put(start, 0);
    queue.offer(start);
    filledTiles.add(start);
    cells[start.row][start.col].setFilled();

    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
        Coordinate current = queue.poll();
        int currentDist = distanceMap.get(current);

        if (currentDist >= distance) {
            continue; // Reached max distance
        }

        for (Direction dir : Direction.values()) {
            Coordinate neighbor = current.add(dir.getOffset());
            if (isValidCoordinate(neighbor) && !distanceMap.containsKey(neighbor)) {
                Cell neighborCell = cells[neighbor.row][neighbor.col];
                if (!(neighborCell instanceof Wall)) {
                    // Fill the cell
                    neighborCell.setFilled();
                    filledTiles.add(neighbor);
                    distanceMap.put(neighbor, currentDist + 1);
                    queue.offer(neighbor);
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```java
		return new Map(rows, cols, cells);
	}

	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateStartCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			int row = rng.nextInt(rows);
			int col = rng.nextInt(cols);
			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			int dir = rng.nextInt(4);
			direction = Direction.values()[dir];

			if (row == 0 || row == rows - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			if (col == 0 || col == cols - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			switch (direction) {
			case UP:
				if (row <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case DOWN:
				if (row >= rows - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case LEFT:
				if (col <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case RIGHT:
				if (col >= cols - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateEndCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			// false -> X-axis, true -> Y-axis
			boolean axisToClamp = rng.nextInt(2) == 1;
			int row = axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? rows - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(rows - 2) + 1;
			int col = !axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? cols - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(cols - 2) + 1;

			if (row == col) {
				continue;
			}

			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			if (axisToClamp) {
				if (row == 0) {
					direction = Direction.UP;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.DOWN;
				}
			} else {
				if (col == 0) {
					direction = Direction.LEFT;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.RIGHT;
				}
			}

			var adjacentCell = coord.add(direction.getOpposite().getOffset());
			if (adjacentCell.equals(sourceCell.coord)) {
				continue;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

	/**
	 * Displays the current map.
	 */
	public void display() {
		final int padLength = Integer.valueOf(rows - 1).toString().length();

		Runnable printColumns = () -> {
			System.out.print(StringUtils.createPadding(padLength, ' '));
			System.out.print(' ');
			for (int i = 0; i < cols - 2; ++i) {
				System.out.print((char) ('A' + i));
			}
			System.out.println();
		};

		printColumns.run();

		for (int i = 0; i < rows; ++i) {
			if (i != 0 && i != rows - 1) {
				System.out.print(String.format("%1$" + padLength + "s", i));
			} else {
				System.out.print(StringUtils.createPadding(padLength, ' '));
			}

			Arrays.stream(cells[i]).forEachOrdered(elem -> System.out.print(elem.toSingleChar()));

			if (i != 0 && i != rows - 1) {
				System.out.print(i);
			}

			System.out.println();
		}

		printColumns.run();
	}

	public void Map(int rows, int cols) {
		this.rows = rows;
		this.cols = cols;
		this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
				cells[r][c] = new FillableCell();
			}
		}
		TerminationCell.CreateInfo sourceInfo = generateStartCellInfo();
		sourceCell = new TerminationCell(sourceInfo.coord, sourceInfo.direction);
		cells[sourceInfo.coord.row][sourceInfo.coord.col] = sourceCell;
		TerminationCell.CreateInfo sinkInfo = generateEndCellInfo();
		sinkCell = new TerminationCell(sinkInfo.coord, sinkInfo.direction);
		cells[sinkInfo.coord.row][sinkInfo.coord.col] = sinkCell;
	}

	public void Map(int rows, int cols, Cell[][] cells) {
		this.rows = rows;
		this.cols = cols;
		this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			System.arraycopy(cells[r], 0, this.cells[r], 0, cols);
		}
		TerminationCell foundSource = null;
		TerminationCell foundSink = null;
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
				Cell cell = this.cells[r][c];
				if (cell instanceof TerminationCell) {
					TerminationCell termCell = (TerminationCell) cell;
					if (termCell.isSource()) {
						if (r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Source cannot be on the edge");
						}
						if (foundSource != null) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Multiple source cells found");
						}
						Coordinate sourceCoord = new Coordinate(r, c);
						Direction dir = termCell.getDirection();
						int[] offset = dir.getOffset();
						int targetRow = r + offset[0];
						int targetCol = c + offset[1];
						if (targetRow >= 0 && targetRow < rows && targetCol >= 0 && targetCol < cols) {
							Cell targetCell = this.cells[targetRow][targetCol];
							if (targetCell instanceof Wall) {
								throw new IllegalArgumentException("Source points into a wall");
							}
						}
						foundSource = termCell;
						sourceCell = termCell;
					} else if (termCell.isSink()) {
						if (!(r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1)) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Sink must be on the edge");
						}
						if (foundSink != null) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Multiple sink cells found");
						}
						Coordinate sinkCoord = new Coordinate(r, c);
						Direction dir = termCell.getDirection();
						int[] offset = dir.getOffset();
						int targetRow = r + offset[0];
						int targetCol = c + offset[1];
						if (targetRow >= 0 && targetRow < rows && targetCol >= 0 && targetCol < cols) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Sink must point outside the map");
						}
						foundSink = termCell;
						sinkCell = termCell;
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if (foundSource == null) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("No source cell found");
		}
		if (foundSink == null) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("No sink cell found");
		}
	}

	boolean tryPlacePipe(int row, int col, Pipe p) {
		int r = row - 1;
		int c = col - 1;
		if (r < 0 || r >= rows || c < 0 || c >= cols) {
			return false;
		}
		Cell targetCell = cells[r][c];
		if (targetCell instanceof FillableCell) {
			FillableCell fillable = (FillableCell) targetCell;
			if (fillable.isOccupied()) {
				return false;
			}
			fillable.setPipe(p);
			return true;
		}
		return false;
	}

	public void undo(final Coordinate coord) {
		int row = coord.row;
		int col = coord.col;
		if (row < 0 || row >= rows || col < 0 || col >= cols) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Coordinate out of bounds");
		}
		Cell cell = cells[row][col];
		if (!(cell instanceof FillableCell)) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cell is not fillable");
		}
		cells[row][col] = new FillableCell();
		filledTiles.remove(coord);
	}
}
```

public void fillTiles(int distance) {
    if (sourceCell == null) {
        return; // No source to start from
    }

    // Clear previous filled tiles if needed
    filledTiles.clear();

    // Queue for BFS: each element is a pair of Coordinate and current distance
    Queue<Coordinate> queue = new LinkedList<>();
    Set<Coordinate> visited = new HashSet<>();

    // Start from the source cell
    Coordinate start = sourceCell.getCoordinate();
    queue.offer(start);
    visited.add(start);
    filledTiles.add(start);
    cells[start.row][start.col].setFilled();

    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
        Coordinate current = queue.poll();
        int currentDist = getDistanceFromSource(current);

        if (currentDist >= distance) {
            continue; // Reached max distance
        }

        for (Direction dir : Direction.values()) {
            Coordinate neighbor = current.add(dir.getOffset());
            if (isValidCoordinate(neighbor) && !visited.contains(neighbor)) {
                Cell neighborCell = cells[neighbor.row][neighbor.col];
                if (!(neighborCell instanceof Wall)) {
                    // Fill the cell
                    neighborCell.setFilled();
                    filledTiles.add(neighbor);
                    visited.add(neighbor);
                    queue.offer(neighbor);
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

The `checkPath()` method should perform a Breadth-First Search (BFS) starting from the source cell to determine if there's a valid path to the sink cell along the pipes. It will traverse only through cells that are either filled or contain pipes that connect the source to the sink, respecting the pipe directions and connections.

Here's a complete implementation of the `checkPath()` method:

```java
public boolean checkPath() {
    if (sourceCell == null || sinkCell == null) {
        return false;
    }

    Set<Coordinate> visited = new HashSet<>();
    Queue<Coordinate> queue = new LinkedList<>();
    Coordinate start = sourceCell.getCoordinate();
    queue.offer(start);
    visited.add(start);

    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
        Coordinate current = queue.poll();

        // Check if we've reached the sink
        if (current.equals(sinkCell.getCoordinate())) {
            return true;
        }

        Cell currentCell = cells[current.row][current.col];

        // Only proceed if current cell is filled or is the source
        if (!(currentCell instanceof FillableCell || currentCell instanceof TerminationCell)) {
            continue;
        }

        // For each direction, check if we can move to the neighboring cell
        for (Direction dir : Direction.values()) {
            Coordinate neighbor = current.add(dir.getOffset());

            if (!isValidCoordinate(neighbor) || visited.contains(neighbor)) {
                continue;
            }

            Cell neighborCell = cells[neighbor.row][neighbor.col];

            // Check if neighbor is a wall
            if (neighborCell instanceof Wall) {
                continue;
            }

            // Determine if there's a valid connection between current and neighbor
            if (canConnect(currentCell, neighborCell, dir)) {
                visited.add(neighbor);
                queue.offer(neighbor);
            }
        }
    }

    // No path found
    return false;
}

    return coord.row >= 0 && coord.row < rows && coord.col >= 0 && coord.col < cols;
}

/**
 * Helper method to determine if two cells can connect in the given direction.
 * This depends on the pipe types and their orientations.
 */
private boolean canConnect(@NotNull Cell fromCell, @NotNull Cell toCell, @NotNull Direction direction) {
    // If either cell is not pipe or fillable, no connection
    if (!(fromCell instanceof FillableCell || fromCell instanceof TerminationCell)) {
        return false;
    }
    if (!(toCell instanceof FillableCell || toCell instanceof TerminationCell)) {
        return false;
    }

    // For TerminationCell, check if it is the sink or source and if it connects properly
    if (fromCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
        TerminationCell termFrom = (TerminationCell) fromCell;
        // Check if the direction matches the source/sink orientation
        if (termFrom.isSource() || termFrom.isSink()) {
            // The source/sink should connect outward in its direction
            return direction == termFrom.getDirection();
        }
    }

    // For pipe cells, check if the pipe at fromCell connects to toCell in the given direction
    if (fromCell instanceof Pipe) {
        Pipe pipe = (Pipe) fromCell;
        // Check if the pipe's orientation allows connection in the direction
        if (!pipe.connectsInDirection(direction)) {
            return false;
        }
        // Also check if the toCell's pipe connects back
        if (toCell instanceof Pipe) {
            Pipe neighborPipe = (Pipe) toCell;
            // The neighbor pipe must connect back in the opposite direction
            return neighborPipe.connectsInDirection(direction.getOpposite());
        } else if (toCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
            // If it's the sink or source, check if it connects properly
            TerminationCell termTo = (TerminationCell) toCell;
            return termTo.getDirection() == direction;
        }
    }

    return false;
}
```

**Note:**  
- The `canConnect()` helper method assumes that `Pipe` class has a method `connectsInDirection(Direction dir)` that returns `true` if the pipe's shape allows flow in that direction.  
- The method also considers that source and sink cells connect only in their specified directions.  
- Adjustments might be needed based on the actual implementation of `Pipe` and `Cell` classes.

This implementation ensures a BFS traversal that respects pipe connectivity and correctly identifies whether a path exists from the source to the sink.

```java
	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateStartCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			int row = rng.nextInt(rows);
			int col = rng.nextInt(cols);
			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			int dir = rng.nextInt(4);
			direction = Direction.values()[dir];

			if (row == 0 || row == rows - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			if (col == 0 || col == cols - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			switch (direction) {
			case UP:
				if (row <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case DOWN:
				if (row >= rows - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case LEFT:
				if (col <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case RIGHT:
				if (col >= cols - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateEndCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			// false -> X-axis, true -> Y-axis
			boolean axisToClamp = rng.nextInt(2) == 1;
			int row = axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? rows - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(rows - 2) + 1;
			int col = !axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? cols - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(cols - 2) + 1;

			if (row == col) {
				continue;
			}

			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			if (axisToClamp) {
				if (row == 0) {
					direction = Direction.UP;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.DOWN;
				}
			} else {
				if (col == 0) {
					direction = Direction.LEFT;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.RIGHT;
				}
			}

			var adjacentCell = coord.add(direction.getOpposite().getOffset());
			if (adjacentCell.equals(sourceCell.coord)) {
				continue;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

	public void display() {
		final int padLength = Integer.valueOf(rows - 1).toString().length();

		Runnable printColumns = () -> {

			System.out.println();

		printColumns.run();

		for (int i = 0; i < rows; ++i) {
			if (i != 0 && i != rows - 1) {
				System.out.print(String.format("%1$" + padLength + "s", i));
			} else {
				System.out.print(StringUtils.createPadding(padLength, ' '));
			}

			Arrays.stream(cells[i]).forEachOrdered(elem -> System.out.print(elem.toSingleChar()));

			if (i != 0 && i != rows - 1) {
				System.out.print(i);
			}

			System.out.println();
		}

		printColumns.run();
	}

	public void Map(int rows, int cols) {
		this.rows = rows;
		this.cols = cols;
		this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
				cells[r][c] = new FillableCell();
			}
		}
		TerminationCell.CreateInfo sourceInfo = generateStartCellInfo();
		sourceCell = new TerminationCell(sourceInfo.coord, sourceInfo.direction);
		cells[sourceInfo.coord.row][sourceInfo.coord.col] = sourceCell;
		TerminationCell.CreateInfo sinkInfo = generateEndCellInfo();
		sinkCell = new TerminationCell(sinkInfo.coord, sinkInfo.direction);
		cells[sinkInfo.coord.row][sinkInfo.coord.col] = sinkCell;
	}

	public void Map(int rows, int cols, Cell[][] cells) {
		this.rows = rows;
		this.cols = cols;
		this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			System.arraycopy(cells[r], 0, this.cells[r], 0, cols);
		}
		TerminationCell foundSource = null;
		TerminationCell foundSink = null;
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
				Cell cell = this.cells[r][c];
				if (cell instanceof TerminationCell) {
					TerminationCell termCell = (TerminationCell) cell;
					if (termCell.isSource()) {
						if (r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Source cannot be on the edge");
						}
						if (foundSource != null) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Multiple source cells found");
						}
						Coordinate sourceCoord = new Coordinate(r, c);
						Direction dir = termCell.getDirection();
						int[] offset = dir.getOffset();
						int targetRow = r + offset[0];
						int targetCol = c + offset[1];
						if (targetRow >= 0 && targetRow < rows && targetCol >= 0 && targetCol < cols) {
							Cell targetCell = this.cells[targetRow][targetCol];
							if (targetCell instanceof Wall) {
								throw new IllegalArgumentException("Source points into a wall");
							}
						}
						foundSource = termCell;
						sourceCell = termCell;
					} else if (termCell.isSink()) {
						if (!(r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1)) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Sink must be on the edge");
						}
						if (foundSink != null) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Multiple sink cells found");
						}
						Coordinate sinkCoord = new Coordinate(r, c);
						Direction dir = termCell.getDirection();
						int[] offset = dir.getOffset();
						int targetRow = r + offset[0];
						int targetCol = c + offset[1];
						if (targetRow >= 0 && targetRow < rows && targetCol >= 0 && targetCol < cols) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Sink must point outside the map");
						}
						foundSink = termCell;
						sinkCell = termCell;
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if (foundSource == null) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("No source cell found");
		}
		if (foundSink == null) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("No sink cell found");
		}
	}

	boolean tryPlacePipe(int row, int col, Pipe p) {
		int r = row - 1;
		int c = col - 1;
		if (r < 0 || r >= rows || c < 0 || c >= cols) {
			return false;
		}
		Cell targetCell = cells[r][c];
		if (targetCell instanceof FillableCell) {
			FillableCell fillable = (FillableCell) targetCell;
			if (fillable.isOccupied()) {
				return false;
			}
			fillable.setPipe(p);
			return true;
		}
		return false;
	}

	public void undo(final Coordinate coord) {
		int row = coord.row;
		int col = coord.col;
		if (row < 0 || row >= rows || col < 0 || col >= cols) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Coordinate out of bounds");
		}
		Cell cell = cells[row][col];
		if (!(cell instanceof FillableCell)) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cell is not fillable");
		}
		cells[row][col] = new FillableCell();
		filledTiles.remove(coord);
	}

	public void fillTiles(int distance) {
		if (sourceCell == null) {
			return;
		}
		filledTiles.clear();
		Queue<Coordinate> queue = new LinkedList<>();
		Set<Coordinate> visited = new HashSet<>();
		Coordinate start = sourceCell.getCoordinate();
		queue.offer(start);
		visited.add(start);
		filledTiles.add(start);
		cells[start.row][start.col].setFilled();
		while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
			Coordinate current = queue.poll();
			int currentDist = getDistanceFromSource(current);
			if (currentDist >= distance) {
				continue;
			}
			for (Direction dir : Direction.values()) {
				Coordinate neighbor = current.add(dir.getOffset());
				if (isValidCoordinate(neighbor) && !visited.contains(neighbor)) {
					Cell neighborCell = cells[neighbor.row][neighbor.col];
					if (!(neighborCell instanceof Wall)) {
						neighborCell.setFilled();
						filledTiles.add(neighbor);
						visited.add(neighbor);
						queue.offer(neighbor);
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
```

- BOT: 
public boolean checkPath() {
    if (sourceCell == null || sinkCell == null) {
        return false;
    }

    Set<Coordinate> visited = new HashSet<>();
    Queue<Coordinate> queue = new LinkedList<>();
    Coordinate start = sourceCell.getCoordinate();
    queue.offer(start);
    visited.add(start);

    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
        Coordinate current = queue.poll();

        // Check if we've reached the sink
        if (current.equals(sinkCell.getCoordinate())) {
            return true;
        }

        Cell currentCell = cells[current.row][current.col];

        // Only proceed if current cell is filled or is the source
        if (!(currentCell instanceof FillableCell || currentCell instanceof TerminationCell)) {
            continue;
        }

        // For each direction, check if we can move to the neighboring cell
        for (Direction dir : Direction.values()) {
            Coordinate neighbor = current.add(dir.getOffset());

            if (!isValidCoordinate(neighbor) || visited.contains(neighbor)) {
                continue;
            }

            Cell neighborCell = cells[neighbor.row][neighbor.col];

            // Check if neighbor is a wall
            if (neighborCell instanceof Wall) {
                continue;
            }

            // Determine if there's a valid connection between current and neighbor
            if (canConnect(currentCell, neighborCell, dir)) {
                visited.add(neighbor);
                queue.offer(neighbor);
            }
        }
    }

    // No path found
    return false;
}

/**
 * Helper method to check if a coordinate is within map bounds.
 */
private boolean isValidCoordinate(@NotNull Coordinate coord) {
    return coord.row >= 0 && coord.row < rows && coord.col >= 0 && coord.col < cols;
}

/**
 * Helper method to determine if two cells can connect in the given direction.
 * This depends on the pipe types and their orientations.
 */
private boolean canConnect(@NotNull Cell fromCell, @NotNull Cell toCell, @NotNull Direction direction) {
    // If either cell is not pipe or fillable, no connection
    if (!(fromCell instanceof FillableCell || fromCell instanceof TerminationCell)) {
        return false;
    }
    if (!(toCell instanceof FillableCell || toCell instanceof TerminationCell)) {
        return false;
    }

    // For TerminationCell, check if it is the sink or source and if it connects properly
    if (fromCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
        TerminationCell termFrom = (TerminationCell) fromCell;
        // Check if the direction matches the source/sink orientation
        if (termFrom.isSource() || termFrom.isSink()) {
            // The source/sink should connect outward in its direction
            return direction == termFrom.getDirection();
        }
    }

    // For pipe cells, check if the pipe at fromCell connects to toCell in the given direction
    if (fromCell instanceof Pipe) {
        Pipe pipe = (Pipe) fromCell;
        // Check if the pipe's orientation allows connection in the direction
        if (!pipe.connectsInDirection(direction)) {
            return false;
        }
        // Also check if the toCell's pipe connects back
        if (toCell instanceof Pipe) {
            Pipe neighborPipe = (Pipe) toCell;
            // The neighbor pipe must connect back in the opposite direction
            return neighborPipe.connectsInDirection(direction.getOpposite());
        } else if (toCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
            // If it's the sink or source, check if it connects properly
            TerminationCell termTo = (TerminationCell) toCell;
            return termTo.getDirection() == direction;
        }
    }

    return false;

If no new tiles have been filled since the last check, it indicates that no pipes were filled during the round, and the game is lost.

```java
	public void Map(int rows, int cols) {
		this.rows = rows;
		this.cols = cols;
		this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
				cells[r][c] = new FillableCell();
			}
		}
		TerminationCell.CreateInfo sourceInfo = generateStartCellInfo();
		sourceCell = new TerminationCell(sourceInfo.coord, sourceInfo.direction);
		cells[sourceInfo.coord.row][sourceInfo.coord.col] = sourceCell;
		TerminationCell.CreateInfo sinkInfo = generateEndCellInfo();
		sinkCell = new TerminationCell(sinkInfo.coord, sinkInfo.direction);
		cells[sinkInfo.coord.row][sinkInfo.coord.col] = sinkCell;
	}

	public void Map(int rows, int cols, Cell[][] cells) {
		this.rows = rows;
		this.cols = cols;
		this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			System.arraycopy(cells[r], 0, this.cells[r], 0, cols);
		}
		TerminationCell foundSource = null;
		TerminationCell foundSink = null;
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
				Cell cell = this.cells[r][c];
				if (cell instanceof TerminationCell) {
					TerminationCell termCell = (TerminationCell) cell;
					if (termCell.isSource()) {
						if (r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Source cannot be on the edge");
						}
						if (foundSource != null) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Multiple source cells found");
						}
						Coordinate sourceCoord = new Coordinate(r, c);
						Direction dir = termCell.getDirection();
						int[] offset = dir.getOffset();
						int targetRow = r + offset[0];
						int targetCol = c + offset[1];
						if (targetRow >= 0 && targetRow < rows && targetCol >= 0 && targetCol < cols) {
							Cell targetCell = this.cells[targetRow][targetCol];
							if (targetCell instanceof Wall) {
								throw new IllegalArgumentException("Source points into a wall");
							}
						}
						foundSource = termCell;
						sourceCell = termCell;
					} else if (termCell.isSink()) {
						if (!(r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1)) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Sink must be on the edge");
						}
						if (foundSink != null) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Multiple sink cells found");
						}
						Coordinate sinkCoord = new Coordinate(r, c);
						Direction dir = termCell.getDirection();
						int[] offset = dir.getOffset();
						int targetRow = r + offset[0];
						int targetCol = c + offset[1];
						if (targetRow >= 0 && targetRow < rows && targetCol >= 0 && targetCol < cols) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Sink must point outside the map");
						}
						foundSink = termCell;
						sinkCell = termCell;
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if (foundSource == null) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("No source cell found");
		}
		if (foundSink == null) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("No sink cell found");
		}
	}

	boolean tryPlacePipe(int row, int col, Pipe p) {
		int r = row - 1;
		int c = col - 1;
		if (r < 0 || r >= rows || c < 0 || c >= cols) {
			return false;
		}
		Cell targetCell = cells[r][c];
		if (targetCell instanceof FillableCell) {
			FillableCell fillable = (FillableCell) targetCell;
			if (fillable.isOccupied()) {
				return false;
			}
			fillable.setPipe(p);
			return true;
		}
		return false;
	}

	public void undo(final Coordinate coord) {
		int row = coord.row;
		int col = coord.col;
		if (row < 0 || row >= rows || col < 0 || col >= cols) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Coordinate out of bounds");
		}
		Cell cell = cells[row][col];
		if (!(cell instanceof FillableCell)) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cell is not fillable");
		}
		cells[row][col] = new FillableCell();
		filledTiles.remove(coord);
	}

	public void fillTiles(int distance) {
		if (sourceCell == null) {
			return;
		}
		filledTiles.clear();
		Queue<Coordinate> queue = new LinkedList<>();
		Set<Coordinate> visited = new HashSet<>();
		Coordinate start = sourceCell.getCoordinate();
		queue.offer(start);
		visited.add(start);
		filledTiles.add(start);
		cells[start.row][start.col].setFilled();
		while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
			Coordinate current = queue.poll();
			int currentDist = getDistanceFromSource(current);
			if (currentDist >= distance) {
				continue;
			}
			for (Direction dir : Direction.values()) {
				Coordinate neighbor = current.add(dir.getOffset());
				if (isValidCoordinate(neighbor) && !visited.contains(neighbor)) {
					Cell neighborCell = cells[neighbor.row][neighbor.col];
					if (!(neighborCell instanceof Wall)) {
						neighborCell.setFilled();
						filledTiles.add(neighbor);
						visited.add(neighbor);
						queue.offer(neighbor);
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	public boolean checkPath() {
		if (sourceCell == null || sinkCell == null) {
			return false;
		}
		Set<Coordinate> visited = new HashSet<>();
		Queue<Coordinate> queue = new LinkedList<>();
		Coordinate start = sourceCell.getCoordinate();
		queue.offer(start);
		visited.add(start);
		while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
			Coordinate current = queue.poll();
			if (current.equals(sinkCell.getCoordinate())) {
				return true;
			}
			Cell currentCell = cells[current.row][current.col];
			if (!(currentCell instanceof FillableCell || currentCell instanceof TerminationCell)) {
				continue;
			}
			for (Direction dir : Direction.values()) {
				Coordinate neighbor = current.add(dir.getOffset());
				if (!isValidCoordinate(neighbor) || visited.contains(neighbor)) {
					continue;
				}
				Cell neighborCell = cells[neighbor.row][neighbor.col];
				if (neighborCell instanceof Wall) {
					continue;
				}
				if (canConnect(currentCell, neighborCell, dir)) {
					visited.add(neighbor);
					queue.offer(neighbor);
				}
			}
		}
		return false;
	}
}
```

```java
package game.map;

import game.map.cells.Cell;
import game.map.cells.FillableCell;
import game.map.cells.TerminationCell;
import game.map.cells.Wall;
import game.pipes.Pipe;
import io.Deserializer;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import util.Coordinate;
import util.Direction;
import util.StringUtils;

import java.util.*;

/**
 * Map of the game.
 */
public class Map {

	private final int rows;
	private final int cols;
	@NotNull
	final Cell[][] cells;

	private TerminationCell sourceCell;
	private TerminationCell sinkCell;

	@NotNull
	private final Set<Coordinate> filledTiles = new HashSet<>();
	private int prevFilledTiles = 0;
	private Integer prevFilledDistance;

	/**
	 * Constructs a map from a map string.
	 * <p>
	 * This is a convenience method for unit testing.
	 * </p>
	 *
	 * @param rows     Number of rows.
	 * @param cols     Number of columns.
	 * @param cellsRep String representation of the map, with columns delimited by {@code '\n'}.
	 * @return A map with the cells set from {@code cellsRep}.
	 * @throws IllegalArgumentException If the map is incorrectly formatted.
	 */
	@NotNull
	static Map fromString(int rows, int cols, @NotNull String cellsRep) {
		var cells = Deserializer.parseString(rows, cols, cellsRep);

		return new Map(rows, cols, cells);
	}

	/**
	 * Tries to place a pipe at (row, col).
	 *
	 * @param coord Coordinate to place pipe at.
	 * @param pipe  Pipe to place in cell.
	 * @return {@code true} if the pipe is placed in the cell, {@code false} otherwise.
	 */
	public boolean tryPlacePipe(@NotNull final Coordinate coord, @NotNull final Pipe pipe) {
		return tryPlacePipe(coord.row, coord.col, pipe);
	}

	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateStartCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			int row = rng.nextInt(rows);
			int col = rng.nextInt(cols);
			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			int dir = rng.nextInt(4);
			direction = Direction.values()[dir];

			if (row == 0 || row == rows - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			if (col == 0 || col == cols - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			switch (direction) {
			case UP:
				if (row <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case DOWN:
				if (row >= rows - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case LEFT:
				if (col <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case RIGHT:
				if (col >= cols - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateEndCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			// false -> X-axis, true -> Y-axis
			boolean axisToClamp = rng.nextInt(2) == 1;
			int row = axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? rows - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(rows - 2) + 1;
			int col = !axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? cols - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(cols - 2) + 1;

			if (row == col) {
				continue;
			}

			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			if (axisToClamp) {
				if (row == 0) {
					direction = Direction.UP;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.DOWN;
				}
			} else {
				if (col == 0) {
					direction = Direction.LEFT;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.RIGHT;
				}
			}

			var adjacentCell = coord.add(direction.getOpposite().getOffset());
			if (adjacentCell.equals(sourceCell.coord)) {
				continue;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

	/**
	 * Displays the current map.
	 */
	public void display() {
		final int padLength = Integer.valueOf(rows - 1).toString().length();

		Runnable printColumns = () -> {
			System.out.print(StringUtils.createPadding(padLength, ' '));
			System.out.print(' ');
			for (int i = 0; i < cols - 2; ++i) {
				System.out.print((char) ('A' + i));
			}
			System.out.println();
		};

		printColumns.run();

		for (int i = 0; i < rows; ++i) {
			if (i != 0 && i != rows - 1) {
				System.out.print(String.format("%1$" + padLength + "s", i));
			} else {
				System.out.print(StringUtils.createPadding(padLength, ' '));
			}

			Arrays.stream(cells[i]).forEachOrdered(elem -> System.out.print(elem.toSingleChar()));

			if (i != 0 && i != rows - 1) {
				System.out.print(i);
			}

			System.out.println();
		}

		printColumns.run();
	}

	public void fillBeginTile() {
		sourceCell.setFilled();
	}
```
